sloka: यस्य पार्श्वेषु निखिला कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ।पावकाशनिसङ्काशो मुद्गरो मूर्तिमान्स्थितः ।। ७.२२.३४ ॥
transliteration: yasya pārśveṣu nikhilā kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।pāvakāśanisaṅkāśo mudgaro mūrtimānsthitaḥ ।। 7.22.34 ॥

translations.english: Then, the enraged Lord Yama, with blood-red eyes, indeed lifted his unfailing rod of death with his hand.
